messages:
maya: noticed a burst of role.create events between 02:10-02:25 UTC after the midnight rekey and IdP mapping push.

sanjay: any SCIM trace id? KMS errors?

maya: trace=scim-rekey-2026. Logs show repeated: "kms:InvalidCiphertext" and occasional "AccessDenied" when unwrapping external_id. snippet: `WARN scim: unwrap failed: kms:InvalidCiphertext arn:aws:kms:eu:acct:key/alias/prod-rekey`

rookie-oncall: infra rotated alias at 01:58 UTC. Terraform output shows scim role ARN missing from new key policy due to variable interpolation bug. Patching now.

sanjay: hypothesis: IdP changed the NameID format (email -> persistent) concurrently. Our canonicalizer tries KMS-unwrap on legacy extid to map users; unwrap failures forced fallback to unhashed extid which created new role bindings and duplicates.

maya: reproduced in staging by flipping NameID and forcing unwrap failure. We see canonical key mismatch: `svc|idp|alice@example.com` vs `svc|idp|S-4433-ALICE` -> duplicate role objects.

audit-bot: AUDIT: 420 role.create entries linked to trace=scim-rekey-2026. Flagging for compliance.

sanjay: immediate fixes: (1) patch key policy to include scim-service-role:Decrypt (infra), (2) add guard in SCIM worker: do not create role if unwrap fails; mark record for manual reconcile and emit audit.warn (eng), (3) add normalization rules for NameID to avoid casing/mapping churn (eng).

rookie-oncall: applied key policy patch and confirmed via `aws kms get-key-policy`. propagation looks good.

maya: PR created to gate on unwrap success and add lowercase/email-normalize. Will run dry-run reconcile once deployed.

sanjay: after code+infra, run `./scim_reconcile --trace scim-rekey-2026 --dry-run` in staging, then run merge tool and entitlement diff.

maya: prepping CSV of affected principals to feed merge script. Will coordinate with compliance for audit window.

rookie-oncall: note for postmortem: root cause = terraform var interpolation bug during key alias swap + simultaneous IdP NameID change. Add automation test to detect missing principals in key policy pre-apply.

sanjay: thanks. Keep updates here and ping me before closing INC-2026.

maya: TL;DR: concurrent KMS alias rotation (missing Decrypt principal) + IdP NameID mapping flip caused SCIM to create duplicate roles. Fixes applied: policy patch, unwrap-gate, normalizer, reconcile+merge. Postmortem pending.
